title: Alert
description: Triggered when an account crosses the 'high' risk threshold. Handoff from ML layer to Agentic AI layer.

account_id.description: The account that triggered this alert.

risk_score.description: The risk score that triggered the alert (copied from the account).

risk_band.description: The risk band. Alerts only fire for 'high' (66-100).

pattern_type.description: Primary suspicious pattern detected by DS-2. 'none' if flagged by score alone. (fan_in and layering cut from scope).

priority.description: Alert priority determined by AI-2 (Alert Agent) based on score + pattern + amount.

summary.description: One-line alert summary generated by AI-2 (e.g., 'High-risk circular transaction pattern detected').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was generated.
